# Project status

**Focus:** Deliver the first release, scheduled in-person sessions with trainer approval and in-person payment.

Edit `status/status.yaml` to change the workstreams. Run `pnpm status:generate` and commit `STATUS.md` with your change; CI fails when it is stale.

## Workstreams

| Workstream | State | Owner | Next | Summary | Links |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Phase 1 foundation | done | - | - | Nx workspace, three Angular apps, NestJS API, Postgres with PostGIS, OpenAPI contract and a login page per app against the real API (development auth). | [phase-1-repo-foundation](docs/plans/phase-1-repo-foundation.md) |
| Design tokens and type scale | done | - | - | Shared UI library uses one set of design tokens, Material is mapped to them, and Inter and Space Grotesk are loaded. | [design-system](.claude/rules/design-system.md), [tokens.css](libs/frontend/ui/src/styles/tokens.css) |
| Client and admin home pages | in-progress | - | Start with the contract entry (HP-1) and the shared UI components (HP-2) in parallel. | Backlog for a minimal client home and an admin home that lists users and trainers by role. | [home-pages](docs/backlog/home-pages.md) |
| First-release PRD review | in-progress | - | Decide minimum booking notice, pending-slot holds, trainer verification and cancellation rules (PRD section 10). | PRD and confirmed product decisions are drafted; several booking rules are still proposals. | [scheduled-in-person-sessions](docs/prd/scheduled-in-person-sessions.md), [first-release](docs/decisions/first-release.md) |
| Feature breakdown | planned | - | Starts after PRD review. | Split the agreed journey into features with acceptance criteria and contract entries. | [scheduled-in-person-sessions](docs/prd/scheduled-in-person-sessions.md) |
| First booking journey | planned | - | Plan it once the feature breakdown exists. | One approved trainer publishes availability and one client requests a scheduled in-person booking that the trainer approves within 24 hours; no platform payments. | [scheduled-in-person-sessions](docs/prd/scheduled-in-person-sessions.md) |
| Cognito hosted login | planned | - | Plan alongside the first booking journey. | Replace development auth with hosted login (OIDC) and JWT verification before a real-user launch. | [Architecture](Architecture.md#6-key-design-areas) |
| Phase 1 follow-ups | planned | - | - | Bundle budgets, sign-out flash, contract-versus-Nest check, axe-core, shared commit guard and Prettier consistency. | [Architecture](Architecture.md#12-known-follow-ups-from-phase-1) |
| On-demand dispatch, online sessions and platform payments | deferred | - | - | Kept in the long-term vision and out of first-release scope until separately prioritized. | [first-release](docs/decisions/first-release.md) |

## Open questions

From the Open questions section of [Architecture.md](Architecture.md). Answer one there and it leaves this list.

| # | Question | Blocks |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Future platform payment model and provider | Future payment collection and payouts; not first-release booking |
| 3 | Video provider (Daily, Twilio, LiveKit, Chime SDK) | Future online sessions; deferred from first release |
| 4 | Maps and geocoding provider | Service area, venue picker, geo search |
| 6 | IaC tool (Terraform or CDK). CI platform resolved: GitHub Actions (D19) | First deployment |
| 7 | Launch country (regulation, currency, payment provider availability, VAT) | Payments, privacy rules |
| 8 | Whether venues become first-class partners | `locations` data model |
| 9 | Trainer verification requirements (documents, background checks) | Onboarding, admin queue |
| 10 | Cancellation and no-show policies; future commission policy | Booking lifecycle; commission is deferred with platform payments |
| 11 | On-demand dispatch: in person only or online too? How are offers ranked (distance, rating, price)? | `dispatch` module, trainer requests screen |
| 12 | Native mobile apps (out of scope at launch) | Nothing now |
